note: First verdict 2026-09-29 (first clause of the §5 sentence; the twice-sent-withdraw clause left with retired RFC7854-5-3). Producer peerHeaderFromEvent sets L only on the sent direction, so a route's announcement and its withdraw take their L from the same direction. Positive rfc7854_test.go::TestRFC7854LFlagFollowsPolicy: a received withdraw carries L clear like a received announce, a sent withdraw L set like a sent announce. Negative ::TestRFC7854LFlagNotDecidedByBody: the same withdraw body on both sides gets L clear and L set, so a withdraw cannot carry the other side's flag. Both observed red under the peerHeaderFromEvent break. The test does not pair one announce with its own withdraw by prefix; the direction is the only input L reads, so no pairing can diverge.
